children: Paladin Energy's FY27 guidance still looks achievable to Macquarie — if the uranium miner can sustain recovery improvements seen through September and ore grades improve. Output at Paladin's Langer Heinrich mine in Namibia was weaker than expected in 1Q. Paladin produced 1.0 million lbs of U308, a common compound of uranium. Still, the company maintained output guidance of 5.1 million-5.6 million lbs of U3O8 in FY27. Macquarie retains an outperform call on Paladin, but cuts its price target by 6.1% to A$13.00/share. Paladin ended Wednesday at A$7.28. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
